answer.reason: The verses tell what was made of the golden calf, how it was worshipped, and how it was destroyed.

clauses.english: was made by Aaron from the people's golden earrings and worshipped with sacrifices as the god that brought Israel out of Egypt
clauses.quote: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto

clauses.english: was burnt by Moses, ground to powder, scattered on the water, and given to the Israelites to drink
clauses.quote: took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder

doubts: NEH 9:18, PSA 106:19 and ACT 7:41 only repeat the event, so they are not cited.
The line leaves out the plague and the slaying of three thousand, which came as punishment on the people and not through the calf itself.
